waivers.lane: DPA G3 — shift-close cash variance GL
waivers.why: The V3 gate RECORDED this contract's target shape as a blocking G3 precondition, so the interface must exist under Shared/Contracts and must be typed. Its parameter DTO carries MovementDirection and MovementReasonCode; hosting the DTO in Shared merely relocates the violation to SharedContracts-on-ModuleDomain, and hosting the ENUMS in Shared is a 76-file / 17-file cross-cutting move that CLAUDE.md rule 4 forbids inside this lane. Exact precedent already at baseline: TreasuryMovementServiceInterface. Reduced from +7 to +1 during gate fix round 1 by removing the Domain exception imports (throws are described in prose) and by hosting the pure-scalar RepositoryAdjustmentResult in Shared/Contracts/Treasury/DTOs alongside OutboundInstrumentIssueResult. Measured: 6d117b511 base = 106, first G3 cut = 113, after restructure = 107.

waivers.line: app/Shared/Contracts/Accounting/DocumentGlCorrectionInterface.php:58,72,82 - assertCorrectingEntryIsWellFormed / assertCorrectingEntryIsPostable / postCorrectingEntryGl, each counted twice (Document parameter + @throws UnpostableCorrectingEntryException)
waivers.why: The SAME violation the three sibling contracts in this directory already carry inside the 29: DocumentGlPreflightInterface:36, DocumentGlReversalInterface:40 and AccountingServiceInterface:37,49 are each typed on App\Modules\Document\Domain\Document and each document a module-domain exception. A Shared contract that lets Document ask Accounting about a document CANNOT avoid naming Document; the alternative - a Shared mirror of the Document entity - relocates the same edge to SharedDomain on ModuleDomain and adds a mapping layer with its own drift surface. This lane deliberately mirrors the established shape rather than inventing a second one, because the correction and the cancellation reversal must agree about what a document's ledger IS (that disagreement is the escape-hatch dead end this lane exists to close). 4 of the 6 arrive with the original branch commits, 2 with the well-formed/postable verdict split.

waivers.lane: N-6 / B-20 Phase 1 — advance on an unposted invoice
waivers.why: Exactly the shape already waived for DocumentGlCorrectionInterface / DocumentGlPreflightInterface / DocumentGlReversalInterface: a Shared contract that lets the Document module hand a Document to Accounting WITHOUT importing GeneralLedgerService (CLAUDE.md rule 6). The contract must be typed on the aggregate it is about, and the only alternatives are worse — pass a bag of scalars (losing the type safety the contract exists for) or let Document import the ledger service (a real Domain-to-Domain cross-module dependency instead of a declared seam). Clearing a customer advance at posting has to be atomic with the seal, so the call site is inside DocumentPostingService::post()'s transaction and cannot be relocated. Recorded by the treasury gate r1 (I-1) as the ACCEPTED half of that finding; the BLOCKER half (DocumentAllocationClassifier in Application) was FIXED by relocating it to Treasury\Domain\Services rather than waived.
